data.name: Error.CabinetLifecycle.NameTooLong
data.value: The firm's name is too long (200 characters at most).

data.name: Error.CabinetLifecycle.Unavailable
data.value: This cell cannot onboard firms: its KMS or its Keycloak service account is not configured.

data.name: Error.CabinetLifecycle.IdentityFailed
data.value: The identity provider did not respond as expected. Try again: every step already done is picked up.

data.name: Error.CabinetLifecycle.NameTaken
data.value: Another firm already has this name. Choose a different name.

data.name: Error.CabinetLifecycle.CellUnknown
data.value: Choose a cell of the platform.

data.name: Error.CabinetLifecycle.CabinetDeclared
data.value: This firm is declared in the server configuration: its departure cannot be requested from Lettra.

data.name: Error.CabinetLifecycle.DepartureNotCancellable
data.value: This firm's departure can no longer be cancelled: the due date has passed or no departure was requested.

data.name: Error.CabinetLifecycle.CabinetLeaving
data.value: This firm is leaving Lettra: it can no longer create client files. Its client files stay open for export until the due date.

data.name: Nav.Platform.Keywords
data.value: platform firms onboard onboarding departure leave cell saas hosting

data.name: PlatformCabinets.Subtitle
data.value: The firms hosted by the platform: their onboarding, their departure and their client file creations. You never see their data.

data.name: PlatformCabinets.NoPlatform.Text
data.value: This screen is for the administrator of the online platform. On a desktop or a firm server, there is no firm to onboard.

data.name: PlatformCabinets.CannotOnboard
data.value: This cell cannot onboard firms yet: its KMS or its Keycloak service account is not configured. Existing firms are still managed here.

data.name: PlatformCabinets.Form.Hint
data.value: Lettra creates the firm, its encryption key and its administrator's account; the administrator receives an e-mail to choose a password and a second factor.

data.name: PlatformCabinets.Declared.Hint
data.value: Firm declared in the server configuration: its departure cannot be requested from Lettra.

data.name: PlatformCabinets.Empty.Text
data.value: Onboard the first firm: it can start working as soon as its administrator has chosen a password.

data.name: PlatformCabinets.Departure.Question
data.value: Request the departure? Everything will be deleted in 30 days.

data.name: PlatformCabinets.Toast.Onboarded
data.value: {0} is onboarded. {1} received the e-mail to choose a password.

data.name: PlatformCabinets.Toast.OnboardedNoEmail
data.value: {0} is onboarded. The e-mail to {1} was not sent: send it again from Keycloak.

data.name: PlatformCabinets.Toast.DepartureScheduled
data.value: Departure of {0} requested: everything will be deleted on {1}. The firm can export its data until then.

data.name: PlatformCabinets.Toast.DepartureCancelled
data.value: Departure of {0} cancelled: nothing changed for the firm.

data.name: PlatformCabinets.Toast.Failed
data.value: The action did not go through. Try again.

data.name: PlatformCabinets.Rule.Onboard
data.value: Onboarding a firm creates its organisation in Keycloak, its root key in the KMS and its administrator's account. Trying again after an error picks up what is already done.

data.name: PlatformCabinets.Rule.Departure
data.value: A departure can be cancelled for 30 days; the firm keeps working and exporting its data meanwhile. Then its databases, its key and its accounts are deleted.

data.name: PlatformCabinets.Rule.Privacy
data.value: Only the firm's identifier, name and dates remain: the proof of its departure, without any data.
